item.description: HYANNIS – An alarm system likely prevented a fire from becoming much more serious. item.description: YARMOUTH PORT – Shortly after after noon on Friday there was a single vehicle crash accident on Main Street (Route 6a) near Kings Circuit in Yarmouth port. item.title: No injuries after car, dump truck collide on Route 6 in Eastham
item.description: EASTHAM – A car and dump truck collided on Route 6 in Eastham about 4 PM Friday. The crash happened on State Highway (Route 6A in front of the Fire Station near Samoset Road. Luckily no injuries were reported. Traffic delays were reported in the area. Eastham Police are investigating the cause of the crash.
